research_goal: policy-matched optimizer-consistent all-109 Direct-TFV receding MPC under sparse causal sensing

core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete H360 reference/candidate actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: label-independent D3 TrainFit HOLD-reference q95 joint temporal trust region
core_pipeline.base_admission: fresh Development D3-HOLD rainfall groups -> 90% one-sided rainfall-group split conformal; historical pre-V6 optimizer replay retained only as diagnostic evidence
core_pipeline.policy_panel: on the same fresh calibration rainfall groups, run the unchanged V6 raw optimizer once per group and label its q95 support-contracted H360 plan with authoritative offline SWMM
core_pipeline.policy_admission: final V7 margin = max(fresh generic-D3 conformal upper, current V6 raw-optimizer rainfall-group conformal upper); obsolete pre-V6 optimizer residual maximum is not a current margin floor
